vectors.rule: A URLError is classified by its code: timedOut (before any answer) and timedOut after part of the answer was shown are different lines; notConnectedToInternet and dataNotAllowed are offline; networkConnectionLost is a dropped connection; cannotFindHost, cannotConnectToHost and dnsLookupFailed are unreachable, worded for a home server when the provider is self-hosted; secureConnectionFailed and the certificate codes are an insecure connection. Any other failure that is not already a worded error shows the catch-all, with the details on the card below it.
